name: mewsic
title: Mewsic
description: Search the albums and songs in your Mewsic library, play them without leaving Raycast, and control playback.
author: jinwei225

commands.name: search-albums
commands.title: Search Albums
commands.subtitle: Mewsic
commands.description: Find an album in your Mewsic library and play, shuffle, queue or open it.

commands.name: search-songs
commands.title: Search Songs
commands.subtitle: Mewsic
commands.description: Find a song in your Mewsic library and play it (its album carries on after it) or queue it next.

commands.name: next-track
commands.title: Next Song
commands.subtitle: Mewsic
commands.description: Skip to the next song in Mewsic.

commands.name: previous-track
commands.title: Previous Song
commands.subtitle: Mewsic
commands.description: Go back to the previous song, or to the start of this one if it is a few seconds in.

commands.name: toggle-shuffle
commands.title: Toggle Shuffle
commands.subtitle: Mewsic
commands.description: Turn shuffle on or off in Mewsic.

commands.name: shuffle-all
commands.title: Shuffle All Songs
commands.subtitle: Mewsic
commands.description: Play your whole Mewsic library shuffled.
